description: This file contains the source code for the CustomField model class in the Opencart catalog account namespace. It defines methods for retrieving custom field data from the database, including specific custom fields and collections filtered by customer group.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: A model class that provides methods to interact with custom fields related to the customer account in the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific custom field by its ID.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves an array of custom fields, optionally filtered by customer group ID, including associated values for select, radio, or checkbox types.
